cards.name: Summer Camp
cards.description: Children participate in arts and crafts, water and sand play, creative expression, group games and quiet times. Attendance is optional and requires advance sign-up; the program is for children registered at Grace Preschool.

season.text: The undated page says the program runs from the end of May to the middle of August.

hours.text: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:30 a.m.-1 p.m.

cards.review_notes: The program page has no summer year or exact dates; prices and hours are undated fallback information assigned to 2026. Ages span the stated preschool groups, Walkers (13–24 months) through Pre-K (4–5 years). No dated age-band sessions were available. The same page says both 'Earlybirds is not offered' and 'Earlybirds drop-off at 8 a.m. is available for $1 per day'; extended care is therefore left null. Preschool and church footers disagree on ZIP code, but agree on street address. Format check: ages 1.0833333333333333 outside 2-19.

cards.name: Vacation Bible School
cards.description: Children attend a community Vacation Bible School offered with Trinity Presbyterian Church and St. James Episcopal Church. The 2026 theme was Operation Restoration.

hours.text: Monday, June 1, through Thursday, June 4, from 9:00 a.m. to noon each day.

cards.review_notes: 2026 dates and hours are corroborated by Grace's official YouTube announcement and the host church's newsletter search results. Rising Pre-K through sixth-grade eligibility and four-year-old minimum come from the host's March 2026 newsletter search snippet. Host newsletter says registration will open in May but provides no exact opening date; no 2027 milestone is posted.
